newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar firms, fresh spec buying.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar firms, fresh spec buying.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were higher at midday after first failing to pierce resistance and then unable to take out support, floor sources said.
The market opened higher, sending the spot-March contract to form a double-top at Tuesday's high of 10.46 cents.
Unable to push on and fill a gap on the charts between 10.47 and 10.50 cents, and stymied by steady producer selling, the contract fell to a low of 10.23, where traders cited firm support.
By midday, speculative short covering and fresh buying had lifted the spot month towards the day's high, and dealers expect the trend to continue through resistance.
"All signals are telling them (speculators) to cover short positions," a trader said. "We could push higher and there is a good chance we'll fill the gap.".
At 1143 EST, March was 0.01 higher at 10.42, traded 10.46 to 10.23 cents. The back months were unchanged to 0.01 firmer, in volume estimated at 12,539 lots at 1100 EST.
